meta.title: Pet Simulator 99 booths data

sources.label: Pet Sim Stats - Tradable Booth Values

meta.countReconciliation: 118 current Pet Simulator Wiki booth rows plus 9 newer BIG Games-verified booth rows: Starry, Patchwork, Dog, Midnight, Bunny, Coral, Noob, Angel, and Void. Pet99Prices tracks 127 booths; Pet Sim Stats lists a smaller tradable-only subset.
